2. Fu Xi / Earlier Heaven — Structure as Geometry
Essence: the timeless binary architecture (yin/yang as 0/1). It is the still axis that prefigures all
motion. Every hexagram here is a structural coordinate; meaning is given by proportion and
symmetry, not narrative.
Mechanisms
Mechanism: polarity → balance → resonance. Opposites are paired (1↔2, 29↔30, 51↔57,
52↔58). Function arises from arrangement; transformation is reconfiguration, not causation.
Human Design / Chart Mapping
HD Mapping: corresponds to Base and Tone (sub-linguistic code). Gates are the raw archetypes
before temporal coloring; lines are viewpoints of stability (1 foundation … 6 integration).
Scientific Correspondence
Science: field symmetry/equilibrium, lowest-energy configuration. In math, binary logic and
group symmetry; in systems, constraints define possibility space.
DNA Analogue
DNA: base-pair complementarities (A↔T, C↔G) prior to replication; symmetric potential before
expression.
Representative Hexagrams / Use-Cases
Examples: read Hexagram 1 (Qian) and 2 (Kun) as pure poles—creative emission vs. receptive
containment. In practice, use Fu Xi to design schemas, ontologies, and protocols (the blueprint
layer).
3. King Wen / Later Heaven — Time as Standing Order
Essence: the arrangement of change inside time. The sequence does not run like a clock; it
stands as a map of temporal resonance; consciousness moves across fixed archetypal
moments.
Mechanisms
Mechanism: ignition → development → crisis → resolution → mastery → transition (lines 1–6 as
temporal stances). Pairs like 63→64 encode the endless approach to completion.
Human Design / Chart Mapping
HD Mapping: Gate/Line as moments of story. The zodiacal order of gates is the spatialized
clock-face of time. Read lines as how you meet the moment (begin, respond, mutate, ally,
culminate, release).
Scientific Correspondence
Science: thermodynamics and kinetics — symmetry-breaking, entropy flow, reaction pathways.
In math: arithmetic/geodesic progression.
DNA Analogue
DNA: replication fork and repair; enzymes move along the backbone—time’s arrow in molecular
form.
Representative Hexagrams / Use-Cases
Examples: 3→4 (birth of learning), 63→64 (completion/before completion). Use this layer for
timing, project phases, and development arcs.
4. Jing Fang’s Eight Palaces — Relation as Network
Essence: the web of interaction. Eight trigram ‘houses’ host families of hexagrams formed by
changing one line at a time. This is the matrix where energies meet, exchange, and stabilize.
Mechanisms
Mechanism: node → edge → feedback → coherence. Circuits form; chemistry appears;
information travels.
Human Design / Chart Mapping
HD Mapping: Centers and Channels. Gates act as social/energetic nodes; lines are styles of
bonding (trust, reflection, experiment, network, guidance, transpersonal view).
Scientific Correspondence
Science: graph theory, neural nets, ecosystems, homeostasis via feedback loops.
DNA Analogue
DNA: chromosomal territories and loop contacts; enhancers/promoters as dialogue across
genomic space.
Representative Hexagrams / Use-Cases
Examples: Palace of Heaven (1, 43, 14, 34, 9, 5, 26, 11). Use for team design, relationship
diagnosis, network architecture.
5. Waxing & Waning (Bigua) — Rhythm as Emotion
Essence: the breathing wave of existence. Twelve phase-hexagrams anchor a full oscillation
(waxing yang → waning yin). Emotion and energy are the same waveform viewed inside the
body.
Mechanisms
Mechanism: inhale → hold → exhale → rest (lines as micro-phases). Resonance regulates
complexity; rhythm restores order.
Human Design / Chart Mapping
HD Mapping: Color/Tone modulation; mood and appetite layers imprint the wave onto
perception and decision.
Scientific Correspondence
Science: oscillations in physics and biophysics (circadian, cardiac, endocrine). Harmonic
analysis (Fourier) captures the spectrum of feeling.
DNA Analogue
DNA: transcription/translation rhythms; bursts of expression; circadian gating of gene activity.
Representative Hexagrams / Use-Cases
Examples: sequence landmarks (1, 34, 62, 56, 30, 55, 64, 63, 29, 3, 24, 2). Use for creative
cadence, recovery cycles, launch timing.
6. Mawangdui — Lineage as Continuity
Essence: the ancestral variation that proves pattern memory. An early order that diverges from
later canon; it shows that systems evolve while preserving identity.
Mechanisms
Mechanism: recursion → inheritance → mutation → integration. History refactors code without
erasing it.
Human Design / Chart Mapping
HD Mapping: Houses/Context. Where and how the pattern embeds socially and culturally; the
arena of expression.
Scientific Correspondence
Science: genetics/evolutionary theory, information storage, error-correction across generations.
DNA Analogue
DNA: methylation/epigenetics and recombination — memory etched into matter.
Representative Hexagrams / Use-Cases
Examples: begins 63→64. Use for cultural analysis, legacy planning, governance, archival
design.

9. Glossary (Quick Definitions)
• Sequence: an ordering principle for the 64 hexagrams (archetypes).
• Gate: one hexagram’s frequency expressed through a human system.
• Line (1–6): a perspective/stance of the gate (foundation → overview).
• Center: domain of awareness (mental, emotional, somatic).
• Color/Tone/Base: sub-linguistic motivational/vibrational layers.
• Palace: a trigram house (Eight Palaces) grouping related hexagrams.
• Standing in time: the idea that the King Wen sequence maps time as fixed resonances;
consciousness moves across them.
10. Final Synthesis
The Five Sequences are a single process seen from five vantage points: structure, time,
relation, rhythm, and lineage. Mathematically they are binary, arithmetic, network, harmonic, and
fractal orders. Scientifically they are symmetry, symmetry-breaking, system formation,
oscillation, and recursion. Psychologically they are self-definition, will, attachment, affect, and
integration. Spiritually they are source, hero, lover, artist, and sage. Biologically they are base
pairing, replication, genomic conversation, transcription rhythm, and inheritance. The same
grammar writes stars, cells, cultures, and souls. Read any chart, project, or relationship through
this codex, and the movement becomes legible.
